blocks.text: A library offers more than a collection. It provides somewhere to sit, a way to reach information, and a person who can help you begin. If we count only borrowed books, we may miss much of what that public space makes possible.

items: Define what a shared public resource makes possible.
Test the claim with verified examples of access to space, information, and support.
Answer the strongest competing use of the same public funds.

items.text: Find and verify local library usage data.
